blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Metro Manila Subway Project (MMSP) and North-South Commuter Railway (NSCR) will be assured of getting funding to prevent further delays in their implementation, Sen. JV Ejercito, who chairs the Senate Committee on Finance, vowed in a statement on Wednesday. “Under my leadership as chairperson of the Committee on Finance, I will make sure that there will be no more delays and that our obligations will be met, especially for the North-South Commuter Railway and the Metro Manila Subway System,” Ejercito said.
